title: User-configurable allowed_directories sandboxing
description: Follow-up to the download_directory user_config added today. Full sandbox: user picks a whitelist of directories the extension can read/write. Every tool that takes a path (fill_pdf, apply_signature, apply_text, display_pdf, list_pdfs, etc.) validates the path is inside the allowlist before proceeding. Matches the Filesystem extension's Allowed Directories pattern Mat screenshotted.
design: manifest user_config block adds 'allowed_directories' with type: directory and multiple: true. Default to [~/Documents, ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop]. Env var ALLOWED_DIRECTORIES passed to server as colon-separated paths. Server maintains a module-level set; resolvePath enforces isInsideAllowlist() and throws a clear error otherwise. Signature storage dir (~/.pdf-toolkit-files/signatures) stays outside the allowlist check — it's internal state, not user-facing paths.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] user_config.allowed_directories renders in Claude Desktop settings
- [ ] Default allowlist = Documents + Downloads + Desktop
- [ ] Every path-accepting tool validates against allowlist
- [ ] Clear error when a tool is called with a path outside the allowlist (e.g. 'This extension is only allowed to access: X, Y, Z. Tried to access: …')
- [ ] Internal signature/profile dir is whitelisted automatically
- [ ] Tests: negative case (rejected path) + positive case (allowed path)
close_reason: Completed

title: v0.8.2 review follow-ups (Unicode + stale select + apply_text case tests)
description: Non-blocking follow-ups from the v0.8.2 adversarial review (blockers B1/B2/F3 and F4 already fixed). Filing these for future hardening — they don't trigger in the current demo flow.
design: (F1) stampTextOnPage throws a deep pdf-lib error on non-ASCII chars (em-dash, accents, smart quotes) because StandardFonts.Helvetica only supports WinAnsi. Catch and rethrow with actionable guidance, or embed a Unicode font (adds bundle weight). Date path is safe (YYYY-MM-DD is ASCII) but the tool is exposed to MCP callers who might stamp Spanish dates, notary names, etc. (F2) openSignModal doesn't reset signModalExistingEl.selectedIndex — a stale saved-signature selection persists across mode switches. Harmless today (date path ignores the select) but a loaded gun for future date-path reads. Explicit reset. (Nice-to-have) Add tests for the apply_text case handler covering allow_resign / force_xfa / same-path guard — helper has unit tests, case handler doesn't.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] apply_text handles non-ASCII cleanly (either rejects with helpful error or embeds a Unicode font)\n- [ ] openSignModal resets selectedIndex = 0\n- [ ] apply_text case handler has integration tests

title: Add rotated-page fixture to golden set
description: Phase A review caught that page rotation wasn't handled (fixed via rotation:0 in getViewport) but there's no test with a /Rotate 90 page to prove the fix holds. Add a synthetic rotated PDF to the golden set.
design: Create test/fixtures/golden-forms/rotated-signature.pdf programmatically via pdf-lib (or use a known public rotated form). Hand-label expected zone. Add to expected.json. Confirms detectSignatureZones returns native-space coords even when page has /Rotate 90.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Rotated fixture added (synthetic or real)\n- [ ] Expected zone hand-labeled\n- [ ] Golden set scores 1.0 on this fixture
notes: Selected after durable output recovery. Extend the original rotated-page golden-fixture request to verify real CropBox plus /Rotate coordinate transforms across PDF.js and Poppler; an independent probe found the current intended-region mask uses crop width as a scalar without transforming the native MediaBox rectangle.
close_reason: Completed original and extended acceptance. Added deterministic SHA-bound rotated-signature.pdf with MediaBox 480x360, CropBox [20,24,430,300], /Rotate 90, exact hand-labeled native zone [72,181,240,18], and required golden score 1.0. Fixed text extraction to use MediaBox dimensions rather than PDF.js CropBox viewport dimensions and fail closed without complete geometry. Existing fidelity campaign case passed 3/3 in PDF.js and Poppler. Independent adversarial review accepted. Focused 34/34, online golden 3/3, full 558/558, share contract 37 tools/14 prompts/112 SBOM/native raster. Follow-up vk8 tracks coordinated nonzero-origin MediaBox normalization.

title: Performance + polish follow-ups from Phase A review
description: Nice-to-haves from Phase A review — not blocking but worth doing when touching detection code again.
design: (1) Font-size fallback floor of 8pt can materialize phantom items from near-invisible decorative text — skip items where all transform components < 0.01. (2) Fixed 18pt right margin in scanPageForLabels — parameterize as 2.5% of page width. (3) SIGNATURE_PATTERNS walks all regex per text item (O(items × patterns)) — combine into one pre-compiled regex with named groups. Matters at 100+ page forms.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Near-invisible items filtered\n- [ ] Right margin proportional to page width\n- [ ] Patterns compiled to single regex with capture groups

title: Optional disclaimer watermark on apply_signature
description: Intent is forgeable by design (documented as tier 1). For high-risk use cases, provide an opt-in 'Not legally binding — basic local stamp' watermark next to the signature. Reduces risk of misuse or user confusion at our 369K install scale.
design: Add disclaimer:true option to apply_signature. When set, draws a small gray text line near the stamp: 'Basic local stamp — not a cryptographic signature.' Already have the coordinate + text drawing path from draw_audit_line; reuse it.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] disclaimer option in tool schema
- [ ] Drawn near stamp when enabled
- [ ] Opt-in (default false) to preserve existing behavior
- [ ] Tested with both typed and image signatures

title: Fuzz malformed PDFs against all mutating tools
description: apply_signature, add_signature_field, prepare_signing_packet, fill_pdf, apply_page_plan all load PDFs and mutate them. A corrupt PDF could crash the process instead of returning a clean error.
design: Add test/fuzz-malformed-pdfs.test.js. Generate 20 bad inputs: random bytes, truncated PDF, HTML, image, empty file, PDF with broken xref. Call each mutating tool with each input. Assert: clean error message, no uncaught exception, no process exit.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] 20 malformed inputs tested
- [ ] All errors surface as clean messages
- [ ] No process crashes
- [ ] No partial output files left on disk
notes: 2026-07-23 accepted implementation commit 9201a4b. The runtime-derived matrix covers all 12 exposed PDF-producing mutators against exactly 20 distinct deterministic malformed fixtures in both source and share runtimes, with persistent-server and fresh-process lanes. It also proves positive controls, valid zero-page and recoverable-parser controls, encrypted behavior, absent and preexisting outputs, merge input ordering, directory creation timing, allowed and rejected same-file behavior, backup and active-document invariants, five-second request bounds, and process liveness. The common loader now normalizes parser failures and iteratively validates every page-tree edge, indirect child, parent link, cycle or duplicate, and declared count before caching only successful SHA-256 digests in a bounded 32-entry LRU. Independent adversarial review APPROVE with no P0/P1/P2. Focused fuzz: 6/6 in 82.41s. Full repository: 76 files and 950/950 tests in 87.86s. A 1,000-page same-server fill control succeeded three times at 190.2, 144.0, and 113.0 ms with valid 1,000-page outputs. Follow-ups: pdf-toolkit-mcp-102 for bounded reads, pdf-toolkit-mcp-33l for a resource-isolated deep campaign, and canonical encryption work pdf-toolkit-mcp-d1y and pdf-toolkit-mcp-8ik.
close_reason: Completed all acceptance criteria with broader source/share, output/state, liveness, structural validation, performance, full-suite, and independent-review evidence in commit 9201a4b.

title: TOCTOU race in findUniquePath (concurrent fetches)
description: Two concurrent fetch_pdf_from_url calls with the same URL both resolve to 'foo.pdf', both write to the same file. Low frequency in real usage but real race.
design: Switch writeFile to exclusive flag 'wx'. On EEXIST, rerun findUniquePath and retry, up to 5 times. Alternative: use a per-user mutex keyed on target path.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] writeFile uses 'wx' flag\n- [ ] Retry loop handles EEXIST\n- [ ] Test with Promise.all of 10 concurrent fetches of same URL — no collisions, no crashes
notes:
Resumed after t0z closed the overwrite side of the race. Current remaining defect: simultaneous overwrite=false downloads can select the same candidate; the locked atomic writer prevents clobbering but losing callers fail instead of retrying to a new unique name. Plan: bounded deterministic retry on exact output-exists classification, preserve canonical committed paths and allowed-directory checks, test Promise.all of 10 identical downloads, source/share parity, off-VM validation, and independent review.
Integrated reviewed implementation on master at 944a05b (implementation commits 5fa4b52, 8b56d4c, 944a05b). Exact reviewed lane SHA af7c90af5aa6bf037fffd2f8b1062901c85a8dfd. Behavior: exact target-loss retry; separate monotonic 30-second lock-contention deadline with 5 to 50 ms capped backoff; exact 999-name namespace bound; unsafe and ambiguous errors are not retried; overwrite=true remains single-shot; fetched bytes and allowed-path policy are preserved across retries. Jex iMac arm64 macOS 26.5, Node 25.8.1, npm 11.11.0, one worker: focused 55/55; adjacent fetch plus atomic plus recovery 141/141. Full candidate 1,021 total, 914 pass, 97 fail, 10 pending; exact parent 1,001 total, 894 pass, 97 fail, 10 pending. Sorted failed-name sets were identical, SHA-256 bfa0726a0c2f1e63f78f1c0ac1c4d626cda477ed8f263f6710bfc70f8f0d4214; candidate-only failures zero. Independent adversarial review APPROVE exact af7c90a with no P0/P1/P2/P3. Source/share helper SHA-256 ac794ffa4257e6f10b536a43fc58628e28532a9def6e91f68dd5bf7c0b38a30d; pdfjs-dist remains exact 5.4.624. No runtime tests ran on Silvercloud.
Exact integrated master 03d6aabbf6c0dbd8546abc692444a1ab4ea30e6e artifact proof on Jex iMac: canonical builder produced two byte-identical clean isolated MCPBs, SHA-256 d084a8dce29623dddc6d20323b6acee4431b5a474dd707ea9aeb3a876f196b79, 73,538,747 bytes, 2,994 entries, peak isolated-build RSS 570,336 KiB. All five locked canvas native targets, manifest schema, pinned MCPB info, and unpack verification passed. Packed darwin/arm64 smoke passed 39 tools, 14 prompts, canonical resources, and native raster. The exact artifact is retained at the ignored local path pdf-toolkit-mcp.mcpb. Private PARA status, worklog, decision, IP-disclosure control, and daily memory were updated and QMD reindexed/embedded. No release, signing, Claude installation, public message, or host-GUI claim occurred.
close_reason: Concurrent same-name downloads now commit distinct PDFs without clobbering or ordinary lock-contention failures. Off-VM focused and adjacent gates pass, full same-host differential has zero candidate-only failures, and independent review approved with no severity findings.

title: Clarify Unicode script-folding scope in olmOCR evaluation docs
description: Independent review of exact a9a70bd found the EVALUATION.md prose frames Unicode superscript/subscript folding primarily around flat math strings, while the normalization applies to every directional scorer type and the retained reference delta is two non-math superscript citation/order cases. Clarify the broader scorer-only scope without changing the pinned scorer, thresholds, or public-claim boundary.

title: Follow-up: detect radio per-widget /AS changes (observation-layer capture)
description: Codex review of the coverage-honesty lane found form-appearance coverage has a real gap for radio groups: pdfjs 5.4.624 does not expose per-widget appearanceState and reports the shared group /V as fieldValue, so a per-widget /AS change with unchanged group /V changes neither value nor the fallback appearance_state and is not detected by compare_pdfs. Currently named as a known gap in docs/MCP_CONTRACT.md and the pdf-comparison.js comment (not claimed covered). To actually detect it, capture the real per-widget /AS in the observation layer (pdf-observations.js) and then compare it. Needs a radio-group fixture with per-widget /AS divergence.
acceptance_criteria: Observation captures real per-widget /AS; a radio /AS-only change is reported as a form_field change; radio fixture added; MCP_CONTRACT gap language updated to covered.

title: Line-segment ruling synthesis for rect-table evidence (pending_lines port)
description: Discovered during zyx.3: tables ruled with individual line segments (moveTo/lineTo strokes) produce no closed-rect evidence, so the rect-grid path cannot see them — the zyx.6 fixture had to be regenerated with cell rects to exercise the feature. pdf-inspector synthesizes rects from line grids (content_stream.rs pending_lines/pending_subpaths); port that as a follow-up with its own fixtures and fail-closed gates. Until then, line-ruled tables abstain truthfully (boundary fixture added in zyx.3 fix round).
